evidence.claim: After being elected prime minister, Shehbaz Sharif announced a parliamentary probe into the 'foreign conspiracy' claim and said he would resign if even a shred of evidence proved it.
evidence.title: New Pak PM Says Will Step Down If "Foreign Conspiracy" Claim Proved
evidence.excerpt: After being elected prime minister, Shehbaz Sharif announced a parliamentary probe into the 'foreign conspiracy' claim and said he would resign if even a shred of evidence proved it.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct report of a parliamentary speech with a specific conditional-resignation quote, but carried by a secondary outlet and attributed to an ANI feed.
evidence.period_fit: Directly within the target year and at the start of Sharif's premiership.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct: this is Sharif's own public statement in parliament.
contrary_evidence: The claim concerned Khan's allegation rather than a completed integrity finding.
Later official review rejected the foreign-conspiracy allegation, so the statement reads as a willingness to submit to scrutiny rather than proof of the allegation.

evidence.claim: FIA counsel told the Lahore special court that no money was directly deposited or withdrawn from the bank accounts of Shehbaz Sharif or Hamza Shehbaz, and that the agency had no evidence of direct transfers into their accounts.
evidence.title: No money 'directly deposited' into bank accounts of Shehbaz, Hamza, FIA tells Lahore court
evidence.excerpt: FIA counsel told the Lahore special court that no money was directly deposited or withdrawn from the bank accounts of Shehbaz Sharif or Hamza Shehbaz, and that the agency had no evidence of direct transfers into their accounts.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: The article reports prosecution statements made in open court in a live money-laundering hearing, which is highly probative even though reported through a newspaper.
evidence.period_fit: Within the target year during the active 2022 money-laundering proceedings.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct to Shehbaz and his son, with the court record focusing on their accounts and alleged benami transactions.
contrary_evidence: The broader case still alleged indirect use of benami accounts and family-linked money flows.
A lack of direct deposit evidence does not by itself rule out all forms of indirect benefit or concealment.

evidence.claim: In the detailed verdict, the judge said FIA failed to prove Shehbaz Sharif and Hamza Shehbaz as beneficiaries of the benami accounts, found no nexus or beneficial interest, and said there was no probability of conviction.
evidence.title: FIA failed to link Shehbaz, Hamza to benami accounts: judge
evidence.excerpt: In the detailed verdict, the judge said FIA failed to prove Shehbaz Sharif and Hamza Shehbaz as beneficiaries of the benami accounts, found no nexus or beneficial interest, and said there was no probability of conviction.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: The article summarizes the court's detailed written judgment, including explicit findings on nexus and benefit.
evidence.period_fit: Within the target year and directly relevant to the same case.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct to Shehbaz and Hamza as the named beneficiaries/defendants in the case.
contrary_evidence: This is one court's verdict in one case and does not prove the absence of every possible conflict of interest in 2022.
The prosecution had advanced serious allegations before the verdict was issued.

evidence.claim: Shehbaz Sharif appointed economist and businessman Miftah Ismail as finance minister and tasked him with arresting the economic spiral and restarting IMF talks.
evidence.title: Pakistan's new finance minister faces tight time frame to tackle crises
evidence.excerpt: Shehbaz Sharif appointed economist and businessman Miftah Ismail as finance minister and tasked him with arresting the economic spiral and restarting IMF talks.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting on a cabinet appointment and the stated rationale for the choice is strong evidence of a professional appointment decision.
evidence.period_fit: Directly within the target year and early in Sharif's premiership.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct: the appointment is attributed to Sharif as prime minister.
contrary_evidence: The source also notes Ismail had a close relationship with Sharif, so the appointment is not purely technocratic.
A single professional appointment does not establish a generally merit-based cabinet.

evidence.claim: PML-N stalwart Ishaq Dar was nominated by Nawaz Sharif and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif during a meeting and then appointed finance minister on the prime minister's advice.
evidence.title: Ishaq Dar appointed federal finance and revenue minister
evidence.excerpt: PML-N stalwart Ishaq Dar was nominated by Nawaz Sharif and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif during a meeting and then appointed finance minister on the prime minister's advice.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous report of a senior cabinet appointment with named nominators and the official appointment basis.
evidence.period_fit: Within the target year and directly tied to Sharif's cabinet decisions.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct and close-network based: the appointment is attributed to Shehbaz Sharif and his family party leadership.
contrary_evidence: Dar was a seasoned finance professional, so the appointment also had competence credentials.
The party-network nature of the decision still raises a favoritism concern even if the appointee was qualified.

evidence.claim: The ministry transcript says the National Security Committee examined the cypher matter, found no evidence of any conspiracy, and stated there was no question or possibility of hiding or holding back the document.
evidence.title: Transcript of the Press Briefing by Spokesperson on Monday, 25 April, 2022
evidence.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Government of Pakistan
evidence.excerpt: The ministry transcript says the National Security Committee examined the cypher matter, found no evidence of any conspiracy, and stated there was no question or possibility of hiding or holding back the document.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official government transcript with direct contemporaneous account of the committee's conclusion and the spokesperson's answers.
evidence.period_fit: Fully within 2022 and directly tied to the foreign-conspiracy claim that dominated the early Sharif period.
evidence.ruler_attribution: This reflects the government's handling under Sharif's new administration and chairmanship of the NSC; it is good evidence of willingness to submit the claim to official scrutiny, not independent forensic proof of all facts.
contrary_evidence: It is an official account of the government's conclusion, so it does not independently verify the underlying cable or resolve all competing political narratives.

evidence.claim: In his inaugural speech, Shehbaz Sharif announced a parliamentary probe into the foreign-conspiracy claim and said he would resign if any shred of evidence proved the allegation.
evidence.title: New Pak PM Says Will Step Down If Foreign Conspiracy Claim Proved
evidence.excerpt: In his inaugural speech, Shehbaz Sharif announced a parliamentary probe into the foreign-conspiracy claim and said he would resign if any shred of evidence proved the allegation.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Syndicated reporting of a live speech, with a clear attributed quote but no direct transcript attachment from the outlet itself.
evidence.period_fit: Directly within the 2022 target period and contemporaneous with the political transition.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct statement by Sharif; it shows an explicit commitment to scrutiny and conditional accountability, but not a later correction by him.
contrary_evidence: A promise to resign if proved is not the same as a later retraction, and it does not by itself establish prior deception or correction.
